summary: 5-day G1 likelihood arc holds: D1 names I/P/C, D2 sorts, D3 predicts using sort, D4 tests across groups, D5 capstone integrates. Walkthroughs cite Fischbein 1975, Jones et al. 1997, Konold 1989, Konold & Pollatsek 2002 with diagnostic A/B/C recovery branches. Lucky+Mae anchor every day with three quotable refrains. Materials everyday with optional puppets. Capstone holds at 3: 5 stations (coin/dice/marbles/weather/sort) integrate D2.1 and D3 prediction strongly but Day 4's across-groups testing dimension isn't its own dedicated station, and worksheet collapses 5 stations into 3 parts.
